title: Import the workspace runtime from its own package
summary: @inventarch/agent-composition-system no longer re-exports the generic workspace runtime. The root exports captureWorkspace, adoptWorkspace, verifyCapture, Corpus, candidateValidation, managedPublication and the Capture type are removed, as are the ./resources, ./projections, ./templates, ./sources, ./authoring, ./authoring-manifest, ./lifecycle, ./lifecycle-profile, ./adapters and ./local-store subpaths and the ./internal/* subpaths of the 18 modules that moved in 1.2.0. Each was a plain alias of the same module in @inventarch/workspace-runtime, so behaviour is unchanged: import those symbols and subpaths from @inventarch/workspace-runtime instead. The package keeps its root (compileHarness, executionManifest, installed, the installed captured read, task capture and installedImplementationDigest), ./tools and the ./internal/* subpaths of the modules it owns.
